title: Best AI Model for Coding in 2026
summary: Claude Opus leads for agentic coding; GPT-5 wins on instruction-following; Gemini 2.5 Flash wins on speed-to-cost. Real benchmarks and verified pricing for 2026.
body_markdown: OpenAI's Codex CLI is a terminal-native agentic coding tool built on the o-series reasoning models. It's used for CLI-driven code generation, automated scripting, and terminal workflows. Benchmark scores are lower than Claude Opus or GPT-5 on autonomous multi-step tasks, but the reasoning-first approach makes it effective on precise algorithmic problems. It's a different tool for a different workflow — not a replacement for Claude or GPT-5 in production agentic coding.
